title: Clearance Request Field Details — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: Assigns one line of the exit clearance checklist to a department. On a parallel approval step, every department's approver looks at the same clearance at the same time, and each is shown only the lines assigned to their role — IT answers the IT lines, Finance the Finance lines. One line can be assigned to more than one department.

fields.label: ClearanceRequestField
fields.rules: Optional. Chosen from Clearance Request Field master data.
fields.html: What it is. The checklist line being assigned.
